name: Small place and time words
rule: Small words like in, on, at and with are fixed by the words around them.
They are learnt in pairs: good at, afraid of, interested in.

wrong.text: My sister is very good in drawing.

right.text: My sister is very good at drawing.

spot: Read the whole phrase aloud. Does the pair sound like one you have heard?
deeper: Time: at 3 pm, on Monday, in June.
Place: at the bus stop, on the table, in the box.
Common pairs: proud of, depend on, agree with, arrive at.
